cmd: (apt-get update -qq && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq xz-utils curl ca-certificates >/dev/null) && mkdir -p out && python -c "import urllib.request as u; u.urlretrieve('https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.11.0/node-v22.11.0-linux-x64.tar.xz','node.tar.xz'); u.urlretrieve('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/KealJones/squiggle/3458ec3/tests/eval/hf-gpu-smoke.sh','smoke.sh')" && tar -xJf node.tar.xz && export PATH=$PWD/node-v22.11.0-linux-x64/bin:$PATH && node --version && bash smoke.sh > out/smoke.log 2>&1; s=$?; cat out/smoke.log; cp /tmp/probe.txt /tmp/case1.json out/ 2>/dev/null; exit $s
note: Third try. webgpu-smoke-1: HF refused the reserved NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES. webgpu-smoke-2: the PyTorch image has no xz, so unpacking Node failed in 4 s (and a trailing '; true' reported it as a success). Now xz is installed first and the script's own exit code is the job's; smoke.log is in out/, so it uploads every 2 min. 45 min cap: at most $0.30.
